message: feat: implement custom Checkbox component and update select-all toggle functionality
post:
Building ApplyOS (applyos.io) involves refining the user experience for managing job applications. A key part of this is the "Apply Kit" feature, which streamlines the application process. 

Initially, the select-all functionality for applications was basic. We needed a more robust way to handle different states: all selected, some selected, or none selected.

This led to implementing a custom Checkbox component. It supports an "indeterminate" state, visually indicating when only a subset of items are selected. This small UI detail makes it clearer to the user which items are being acted upon, especially when bulk actions are involved.

How do you approach custom UI components to ensure they are both functional and accessible?
alt: A custom checkbox component that can display a checked state, an unchecked state, or an indeterminate state represented by a minus sign.
